name: North Dakota
standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (stated goal; ADA Title II)

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web & mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by IFR 2026-07663)
laws.summary: Federal floor: state and local government web content and mobile apps must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA; the April 2026 IFR moved compliance to 2027-04-26 (pop. 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: ADA Digital Accessibility — What State Agencies Need to Know (one-pager)

applies_to: State agencies (statewide initiative); local governments via ADA Title II.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II rule: state government and local governments with population 50,000+ must conform web content and mobile apps to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
ADA Title II rule: local governments under 50,000 and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Statewide Siteimprove enterprise agreement for scanning
Keep good-faith records of content reviewed and remediated (one-pager guidance)
All public-facing content incl. web, mobile apps, documents, media, third-party tech in scope
mobile: explicit — NDIT one-pager lists web and mobile applications as content that must be accessible.
enforcement: No state enforcement found; report issues to itservicedesk@nd.gov / 701-328-4470; ADA Title II.
notes: NDIT Web Development Standard POL0020014 exists but redirects to wiki.nd.gov, which did not resolve; its accessibility content is unverified. A search snippet says State Website Platform sites are WCAG 2.0 AA. NDIT cites N.D.C.C. ch. 54-59 (NDIT's enabling chapter) generally; no accessibility statute found.
